app.noReports.body: VITE_FEATURES names no report this app knows. Enable at least one feature flag and rebuild.
app.modes.overridden: This tab overrides the deployed modes from the URL, which may be why.
app.modes.reset: Reset the modes for this tab
app.bootstrap.title: Couldn't start the dashboard
app.bootstrap.body: Check the app configuration or refresh to try again.
app.reportLagNote: Microsoft usage reports lag by two to three days.
header.refreshHint: Reload the report from Microsoft Graph
header.helpHint: How each report works, its settings and setting up access
header.settingsHint: Currency, cost per GB, the SharePoint entitlement and OneDrive storage per user
header.switchAccountHint: Sign in with a different Microsoft account
settings.title: Report settings
settings.description: Cost assumptions, the tenant entitlement, OneDrive storage per user and when a site counts as inactive. Saved in this browser only.
settings.rateHint: Used for the cost of doing nothing, the growth cost and the potential saving.
settings.entitlementHint: Estimated from licences: {estimate}. Enter the figure from the SharePoint admin centre to replace it; clear it to go back to the estimate.
settings.entitlementHintNoEstimate: Enter the figure from the SharePoint admin centre.
settings.oneDriveEntitlementHint: From licences: {estimate} {unit} — the most generous plan in the tenant (5 TB on E3, E5, G3 and G5 with five or more licences, 1 TB on Business plans, 2 GB on frontline). Enter a figure to replace it; clear it to go back to the estimate.
settings.oneDriveEntitlementHintNoEstima: What each user licence includes: 5 TB on E3, E5, G3 and G5 with five or more licences, 1 TB on Business plans, 2 GB on frontline.
settings.inactiveYearsHint: A site with no activity for this long counts as ready to archive. Default {years} years.

loading.starting.footer: Your storage report will appear shortly
loading.signingIn.title: Signing you in
loading.signingIn.subtitle: Confirming your Microsoft 365 account.

auth.notAssigned.title: Your account is not allowed to use this app
auth.notAssigned.body: Your organisation limits this report to chosen users or groups, and your account is not one of them. An administrator can add you under the app's Users and groups in Microsoft Entra.
auth.consent.title: Your organisation has not approved this app yet
auth.consent.body: This report only reads Microsoft 365 data, but a Global Administrator has to grant admin consent once before anyone in your tenant can use it.
auth.consent.linkTail: — you will be asked to review the read-only permissions this report needs, then returned here.
errors.insufficientPermissions: Insufficient permissions — admin consent or the required role may be needed for this report.
access.consent.title: Your organisation has not approved this app yet
access.consent.body: Approving sign-in is not enough: the report reads your tenant with application permissions, which a Global Administrator has to grant once for the whole tenant. Signing in again will not help until they do.
access.consent.delegatedBody: The report reads usage reports as you, and your organisation has not granted it that permission yet — signing in does not grant it, and no role of yours changes that. A Global Administrator has to grant admin consent once for the whole tenant.
access.permissions.intro: The grant covers these read-only permissions, and Microsoft lists the same ones on its consent page:
access.permissions.reports: Microsoft 365 usage reports: storage per site and per OneDrive
access.permissions.organization: tenant name and licences, for the storage entitlement and OneDrive storage per user
access.tenant.title: This tenant is not enabled for the report yet
access.tenant.body: You signed in successfully, but your tenant has not been switched on for this report. No role or consent will change that — ask Proventeq to enable it.
access.permission.title: Your account cannot read usage reports
access.permission.body: You are signed in and your organisation has approved the app, but reading tenant usage reports needs an administrative role. Microsoft requires Global Reader, Reports Reader, or an equivalent role — ask an administrator to assign one.
help.center.notFoundTitle: This help page does not exist
help.center.notFoundBody: It may have moved. Start from the overview, or search the help.
helpButton.label: About {title}
table.column.help.site: The site's display name and a link to it, looked up in the tenant site directory because Microsoft's usage report leaves the URL blank. A site the signed-in account cannot open, or one that has been deleted, shows its owner and site id instead.
table.column.help.drive: The OneDrive account, named after its owner, with a link to the drive.
table.column.help.owner: The primary owner as Microsoft's usage report records it. For group-connected sites this is the Microsoft 365 group's owners.
table.column.help.files: Files stored, as of the report date.
table.column.help.active: Files that were created, edited or otherwise active during the 180-day reporting period.
table.column.help.used: Storage consumed, as Microsoft's usage report measures it, as of the report date.
table.column.help.share: This row's storage as a percentage of everything this table covers. The bar is drawn to the same scale.
table.column.help.lastActivity: The most recent day with file activity in the 180-day reporting period. Never means no activity was recorded in that period.
table.column.help.template: The SharePoint template the site was created from. Team Channel and Group templates count as Teams in the workload split; everything else counts as SharePoint.
table.column.help.capacity: How much of the drive's own storage allocation is used — the per-user cap a OneDrive can actually hit. Blank for sites, whose allocation is the 25 TB site-collection maximum rather than a quota.
table.column.help.overEntitlement: How much more the drive holds than the OneDrive storage per user this report measures against.

reports.storageOptimisation.title: Storage Optimisation
reports.oneDriveUsage.title: OneDrive Usage
storageOptimisation.description: A consolidated summary of tenant storage — where it sits today, where it is heading, and what drives it.
storageOptimisation.capacity.title: Tenant capacity
storageOptimisation.capacity.subtitle: What archiving inactive sites could save, what growth beyond your licensed entitlement will cost, and when that entitlement runs out
storageOptimisation.kpi.archivableHint: {percent} of SharePoint storage, in {sites} {count, plural, one {site} other {sites}} with no activity for {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} (since {date}).
storageOptimisation.kpi.archivableNoneHi: No site has gone {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} without activity (since {date}).
storageOptimisation.kpi.savingHint: Storage cost avoided if the {size} of inactive sites is archived, valued at {rate}/GB per month.
storageOptimisation.kpi.savingNoneHint: Nothing to save until a site passes the inactivity threshold in Report settings.
storageOptimisation.kpi.costOfNothing: Cost of doing nothing, next 12 months
storageOptimisation.kpi.costOfNothingHin: Extra spend over the next 12 months on growth beyond your entitlement, valued at {rate}/GB per month. Zero while growth stays within it.
storageOptimisation.kpi.forecastInsuffic: A forecast needs {months} months of measured storage history. This is not an all-clear — it appears once Microsoft 365 has reported enough.
storageOptimisation.kpi.forecastHint: The month SharePoint storage passes your {entitled} entitlement if it keeps growing {growth} a month. {remaining} of headroom is left.
storageOptimisation.kpi.forecastBeyondHo: At {growth} a month, the {remaining} of headroom left under your {entitled} entitlement lasts more than {years} years.
storageOptimisation.kpi.forecastNoGrowth: SharePoint storage has not grown over the last {months} months, so it is not on course to pass your {entitled} entitlement.
storageOptimisation.kpi.forecastUnknownH: Needs the tenant entitlement. Enter it in Report settings to see when SharePoint storage runs out.
storageOptimisation.distribution.title: Current storage distribution
storageOptimisation.distribution.subtitl: Where storage sits today — quota usage, workload split, and which site types drive the volume
storageOptimisation.quota.title: Quota usage
storageOptimisation.quota.scopeNote: Tenant-wide usage against the Microsoft 365 entitlement
storageOptimisation.quota.entitlementUnk: Tenant entitlement unavailable, so quota usage cannot be shown. Enter it under Options, Report settings.
storageOptimisation.workload.title: Storage by workload
storageOptimisation.workload.subtitle: SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive, as reported by Microsoft 365
storageOptimisation.workload.groupingNot: Grouped by site template, which is what Microsoft Graph reports. These counts will not match the SharePoint admin centre, which groups differently.
storageOptimisation.template.title: Storage by site template
storageOptimisation.template.subtitle: SharePoint storage grouped by the template each site was created from
storageOptimisation.growth.sectionSubtit: Where storage is heading at the current growth rate — and what it costs if nothing changes
storageOptimisation.growth.forecastIndet: Not enough history to forecast capacity
There are too few months of measured growth to project a trajectory. This is not an all-clear — the forecast will appear once more history has accumulated.
storageOptimisation.growth.alreadyExhaus: The tenant is already using more than its pooled entitlement, so there is no future exhaustion date to project. Procurement or cleanup is needed now.
storageOptimisation.growth.forecastUnava: Capacity forecast unavailable without tenant entitlement
The tenant storage quota could not be read, so headroom and exhaustion cannot be projected. Enter your real entitlement in settings to see them.
storageOptimisation.growth.estimatedQuot: Your storage quota was estimated from licence counts rather than read from Microsoft, so the headroom and cost figures are approximate.
storageOptimisation.growth.volatileNote: The monthly figures the rate is derived from are uneven — one month dominates rather than a steady trend — so a single average is a weak guide here. Treat the projection as indicative.
storageOptimisation.growth.impactNote: At the current growth rate the tenant is projected to pass its pooled entitlement on this trajectory. Procurement or cleanup is needed before then.
storageOptimisation.growth.impactNoteNoA: At the current growth rate the tenant is projected to pass its pooled entitlement on this trajectory, but not for years — capacity needs no action today.
storageOptimisation.growth.noExhaustionN: At the current growth rate the tenant stays within its pooled entitlement for at least the next {years} years.
storageOptimisation.growth.costSubtitle: Extra spend once storage grows past the entitlement, at the configured rate.
storageOptimisation.offenders.title: Main offenders
storageOptimisation.offenders.subtitle: The sites and drives driving the most storage
storageOptimisation.offenders.retainedNo: {count} sites and drives are deleted but still consuming quota under retention.
storageOptimisation.offenders.allSubtitl: Every site and drive in the usage reports, sortable and searchable
storageOptimisation.hiddenNamesNote: Site names and owners are hidden: sites show as masked ids, owners as initials, and site links are removed. The storage figures are unaffected.
storageOptimisation.concealedNamesNote: Your tenant conceals user and site names in usage reports, so identities below appear as hashes. The storage figures are unaffected. To show real names: Microsoft 365 admin centre → Settings → Org settings → Reports → uncheck "Display concealed user, group, and site names".
oneDrive.description: How much of the tenant sits in personal OneDrives, who holds the most, and which drives are running out of room.
oneDrive.kpi.drivesHint: Active drives in the usage report
oneDrive.kpi.nearCapHint: At 90% or more of their own allocation
oneDrive.kpi.nearCapNone: No drive is close to its cap
oneDrive.kpi.retainedHint: {count} deleted drives still consuming quota under retention
oneDrive.kpi.overLicenceNone: Every drive fits within {entitlement} per user
oneDrive.kpi.overLicenceUnknown: Licences unavailable — set OneDrive storage per user in Report settings
oneDrive.kpi.overLicenceNoSizedPlan: No licence with a known OneDrive allowance — set it in Report settings
oneDrive.overLicence.title: OneDrives over their licensed storage
oneDrive.overLicence.subtitle: Accounts holding more OneDrive storage than any licence in the tenant includes ({entitlement} per user)
oneDrive.overLicence.subtitleSet: Accounts holding more than the {entitlement} of OneDrive storage per user set in Report settings
oneDrive.overLicence.subtitleUnknown: Accounts holding more OneDrive storage than any licence in the tenant includes
oneDrive.overLicence.unknown: The tenant's licences could not be read (the Organization.Read.All permission was not granted), so the storage each user is licensed for is unknown. Set it in Options, Report settings.
oneDrive.overLicence.noSizedPlan: None of the tenant's licences has a OneDrive allowance this report knows (education allowances vary by agreement; developer and add-on plans are not sized here), so the storage each user is licensed for is unknown. Set it in Options, Report settings.
oneDrive.overLicence.label: OneDrives over licensed storage
oneDrive.overLicence.note: Measured against the most generous plan the tenant holds: 5 TB on E3, E5, G3 and G5 with five or more licences, 1 TB on Business plans, 2 GB on frontline. Microsoft does not report which licence each user holds; set a different figure in Options, Report settings.
oneDrive.overLicence.noteSet: Measured against the figure set in Options, Report settings. Clear it there to go back to the estimate from licences.
oneDrive.overLicence.noteSetNoEstimate: Measured against the figure set in Options, Report settings. The tenant's licences give no estimate, so clearing it leaves the figure unknown.
oneDrive.top.title: Top OneDrives by storage
oneDrive.top.subtitle: The five largest personal drives
oneDrive.table.title: All OneDrives
oneDrive.table.subtitle: Every personal drive in the usage report, with how much of its own allocation it uses{retained, plural, =0 {} one { — including # deleted drive still under retention} other { — including # deleted drives still under retention}}
oneDrive.table.label: OneDrives
oneDrive.allocationNote: Each OneDrive has its own allocation, so capacity is meaningful per drive. It is not pooled with SharePoint.
